b:
To my friend,
who gave me a new friendship
after I had grown tall

This is a gift of love
I give
in beautiful Tamil

In the middle of your heart,
which never changes,
the children in our hearts
ran around and played

Even long journeys
are not sweet
without contact with you

You are
the centre
of our friendship

The feminism that wandered
on paper
I saw come alive
in you

Had he seen you,
Bharathi too
would have drenched you
in a rain of poetry

In this world
full of longing,
the hope you show
for tomorrow
is brighter
than the stars

Tomorrow's history too
is waiting
to record
your achievements

Fill
those pages
with the ink of your pen

as a fine writer
with a stethoscope round your neck

and in your sixties, with this same
energy …

Today,
on this day,
stride forward

Forever your
loving friend,
I
note: Subramania Bharathi was the great Tamil poet who championed women's freedom.
